text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product with its own published beam and diffuse, minus with the Erbs split of its own global irradiance. SARAH-3 is left out: its direct beam is modelled from its own global irradiance. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Six solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to August 2026. All rows are exploratory.'
